mapper.select: SELECT p.p_code, subcategory_id, p_name, p_price, p_image, p_rating FROM products p join favorites f on p.p_code = f.p_code WHERE f.m_code = #{m.code} ORDER BY f.a_code desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITES (A_CODE, M_CODE, P_CODE) VALUES ('FV' || LPAD(SEQ_FAVORITES.NEXTVAL, 5, '0'), #{m_code}, #{p_code})
mapper.select: SELECT p.p_code AS p_code, p.p_name AS p_name, p.p_price AS p_price, p.p_image AS p_image, p.p_rating AS p_rating, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, s.name AS subcategoryName, -- ✅ 하위 카테고리명 c.name AS categoryName -- ✅ 상위 카테고리명 FROM FAVORITES f JOIN products p ON f.p_code = p.p_code JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id JOIN categories c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.m_code = #{m_code} ORDER BY c.category_id, s.subcategory_id

SELECT p.p_code AS p_code, p.p_name AS p_name, p.p_price AS p_price, p.p_image AS p_image, p.p_rating AS p_rating, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId FROM FAVORITES f JOIN products p ON f.p_code = p.p_code WHERE f.m_code = #{m_code} AND p.subcategory_id = #{categoryId}
